answer: Since you financed through Bayline Credit Union, we sent the title paperwork to Bayline, and they hold the title (or electronic title record) until the loan is paid off. You don't need the title in hand to sell: at the appointment we confirm what you owe and pay Bayline directly from your offer. A payoff letter isn't strictly required, but getting one before you come in speeds things up, and you can sign form NW-LPA-1 to have us request it for you (allow 2 business days); if your lender is in our e-payoff network, you don't need a letter at all. The help center doesn't say whether Bayline Credit Union is in that network, so please contact a store to confirm.
